question: Where are a restaurant located within 20 kilometers distance toward the north of East Neck Nursing and Rehabilitation Center, West Babylon, NY?
sql: WITH reference_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%East Neck Nursing and Rehabilitation Center%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, reference_point AS rp WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, rp.geometry::geography, 20000) AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(rp.geometry), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(rp.geometry), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 );
